West Bengal Voter Claims Stuck Amid Vacant Tribunals

Over 3.7 million voter claims in West Bengal are in limbo due to three vacant tribunals for the Special Investigation Register (SIR), with only 100,000 appeals processed. Tribunal judges have raised questions about the ECINET system's shortcomings, noting a lack of facility to reinstate deleted voters.
